messages:
tara (Product): FYI: LiteServe published a post claiming 12ms p95 for 1024-d embeddings on multi-tenant hosted infra. Multiple AE's flagged it. https://liteserve.example/blog/lite-embed :eyes:

ben (Sales): Heard from three deals. Main ask: can we match without quality loss? If not, need a rebuttal one-pager ASAP.

diana (Eng Runtime): quick read: likely achieved via aggressive caching + smaller model. Matching at scale may need infra changes (NIC-level cache, different batching). Need spike to quantify.

kai (Eng-ML): quality-first check: smaller/quantized models often drift. I can run a recall@10/embedding-drift test if we produce a quantized checkpoint. ETA 6 working days.

sophie (Design): I'll draft a neutral comparison one-pager that shows tradeoffs (latency, recall, cost) and an FAQ for AEs. 2 days if we lock content.

ben (Sales): priority: one-pager + an optional pilot offer (fast-tier) for top accounts. Will commit AE time to run pilots.

legal-bot: reminder: any public competitor comparisons must be fact-checked. Legal review required before publish.

diana (Eng Runtime): propose MLP: 1) 7-day spike to prototype quantized runtime and measure p95/p99 at 50rps and 300rps, 2) run quality eval with Kai on three corpora, 3) produce internal perf/cost delta + one-pager.

kai (Eng-ML): will run evals: websearch, product-recs, and support-search. Need Miguel's quantized scripts.

tara (Product): decision path: if recall@10 drop <=5% and latency improves >1.5x p95, ready a fast-tier tech-preview. If quality loss >8%, publish a quality-first positioning doc and prioritize batching/infra work.

sophie (Design): noted. I'll start the template and slot content placeholders for numbers.

ben (Sales): I'll prep a short list of priority pilot accounts and get LOIs.

diana (Eng Runtime): ops-bot: scheduled: embed-fast-proto started by diana at 2176000012

tara (Product): reconvene in 8 working days with spike + eval numbers. If spikes show acceptable tradeoffs, we fast-track a pilot lane. If not, we own the quality narrative and offer PS for sensitive low-latency needs. :handshake:
